components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (typically MR, MRS,
            MS or DR). When supplied it is combined with the last name to derive
            the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility with the flat address form. On create it is
            normalized and, when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied,
            the returned value is composed from the structured fields instead.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When a
            non-blank value is supplied the structured form is preferred over the
            flat 'address'. Normalized on create (trimmed, whitespace collapsed,
            upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. Normalized like 'addressLine1'; when present it is appended
            to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+'
            and country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postal code of the pet owner. Optional; when present it
            must be valid for the owner's city per a fixed region table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when not
            supplied it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it is used to
            derive the owner's 'ageBand'. Given and returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner
            already shares its household (same last name and postcode) that
            would otherwise be rejected as a household duplicate; such a declared
            member is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Write-only; used only
            during create and not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical link to this owner resource, formed as
                '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '/api/owners/1'
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as "LastName, FirstName".
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived on read as the title followed by
                a space and the last name (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last name
                when no title is given.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in
                threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived on read; the raw
                'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A generated customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned on create.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007'
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              readOnly: true
              example: 4
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                A generated membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year of the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate (the fiscal year starts
                on 1 July).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007-M27'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal
                year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a registrationDate on
                or after 1 July falls in the fiscal year ending the following
                calendar year. Absent when no registrationDate is recorded.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'FY27'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-

I redesigned the identity key and duplicate detection to match the new specification. The test suite passes (`BUILD SUCCESS`, 2/2 tests green).

### Changes

**`Owner.java`** — `getIdentityKey()` now returns the full lower-case hex **SHA-256** over `normalizedTelephone + '|' + lowerEmail + '|' + soundex(lastName)` (previously a plain concatenation of `telephone|email|householdId`). **`openapi.yml`** — updated the `identityKey` field description and example to reflect the 64-hex SHA-256 form.

The exact soundex output isn't asserted by the tests (their oracle is "identical identity → 409" plus the 64-hex shape), and the same `Owner.soundex` is used for both the key and the soft-match, so the two stay consistent.
